prompt: Full body portrait, a Chinese military regiment commander standing at attention in 1941. **Subject:** Man in his early forties with commanding authoritative presence and deeply weathered experienced features. Most distinctive are the exceptionally rough, heavily calloused hands with prominent weathered texture and visible work-worn skin - the unmistakable hands of a veteran field commander who has endured countless campaigns. Deep-set grave eyes radiating steely determination and resolute authority, graying hair at temples showing years of dedicated service, angular weathered face with prominent cheekbones and serious expression. Wearing a faded grayish-blue Eight Route Army officer uniform with distinctive red collar tabs indicating regiment-level rank, worn fabric texture from extended field service, sturdy leather belt with brass buckle, small leather map case secured to belt side, weathered cotton shoes. **Exposure:** ISO 200, f/5.6, 1/60s. **Lighting:** Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the front-left, creating strong contrast between light and shadow across the weathered face and rough calloused hands, emphasizing the hand texture and historical gravity of command authority. **Composition:** Subject centered, standing rigidly straight with commanding military bearing projecting absolute authority, hands naturally at sides with rough weathered texture prominently visible. **Depth of Field:** Deep focus keeping entire figure sharp with emphasis on hand detail. **Background:** High contrast, single solid dark olive-brown background. **Lens:** 85mm prime lens. **Genre:** Historical portraiture, realistic thick-painted 2D animation style. **Style:** Strong light-dark contrast, low-saturation earthy color palette with muted blues and browns, serious and epic mood emphasizing command gravitas, realistic brush stroke textures, painterly quality. Shot at eye level.
